en.name: Tandoori paste
en.summary: Jarred tandoori paste is an acidified, salted, oil-bearing spice base that you mix with yoghurt to marinate meat. Unopened it keeps about 2 years in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and use within about 1–2 months, or follow the maker's opened-life statement if the label gives one.
en.pantry: Unopened, keep it in a cool dark cupboard to its printed date, about 2 years from purchase — a figure taken from Thai red curry paste, the nearest published product. Keep the jar away from the hob and out of the sun; the oil in it is what stales first. Once the seal is broken the cupboard is no longer right, and a jar that has lost its vacuum should not be kept at all.
en.fridge: Refrigerate once opened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 1–2 months. That window is wider than the curry-paste line it is based on, because a commercial tandoori paste is acidified, salted and carries oil — but if the label states an opened life, follow the label in preference. Always take the paste out with a clean dry spoon and wipe the rim before the lid goes back on. Two habits ruin a jar: leaving oil-free paste exposed at the top, where it dries and moulds, and dipping a spoon that has touched raw chicken. Fresh homemade tandoori marinade is yoghurt-based and perishable: keep it at 4 °C and use it within two days.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for jarred tandoori paste and it rarely needs one, since the fridge gives an opened jar weeks to months. Freezing is genuinely useful for a homemade spice base or for a large jar you cannot finish: freeze tablespoon blobs at −18 °C (0 °F) and bag them. Do not freeze a yoghurt marinade on its own; freeze the chicken in it instead, and it marinates as it thaws in the fridge.
en.thawing: Thaw a frozen blob in the fridge or drop it straight into a hot pan. Thaw marinating meat in the fridge only, and discard the used marinade rather than reusing it.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or on paste standing above the oil
A rancid, crayon-like smell from the oil
A fermented or yeasty smell, gas, or a domed lid
The surface dried into a dark crust with liquid separated beneath
tips: Spoon out what you need before the meat comes anywhere near the jar.
Wipe the rim and level the surface after every use.
Marinade that has held raw meat is contaminated: bin it, never return it to the jar or brush it onto cooked food.
Freeze a big jar in tablespoon blobs rather than letting it sit open for months.

faq.q: How long does tandoori paste last once opened?
faq.a: About 1–2 months refrigerated at 4 °C or below, or the maker's stated opened life if the label gives one.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar keep?
faq.a: About 2 years in a cool dark cupboard, to the printed date. That figure is borrowed from Thai red curry paste.

faq.q: How long does homemade tandoori marinade keep?
faq.a: It is a yoghurt-based dairy preparation: keep it at 4 °C and use it within two days.

faq.q: Can you reuse tandoori marinade that held raw chicken?
faq.a: No. It is contaminated. Discard it rather than brushing it onto cooked food or returning it to the jar.

zh.name: 坦都里醬
zh.summary: 罐裝坦都里醬是經過酸化、含鹽又帶油的香料基底，使用時和優格拌在一起醃肉。未開封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 2 年。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完；若標籤有註明開封後的使用期限，以標籤為準。
zh.pantry: 未開封請放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 2 年——這個數字取自泰式紅咖哩醬，那是最接近且有公布數字的產品。請遠離爐火、避免日曬；醬裡的油是最先走味的部分。封口一開，櫥櫃就不再合適；已經沒有真空感的罐子則根本不該留。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完。這個窗口比它所依據的咖哩醬數字寬，因為市售坦都里醬經過酸化、含鹽又帶油——但若標籤註明了開封後期限，請以標籤為優先。每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙取用，蓋回去前擦一下瓶口。兩個習慣會毀掉一罐：讓沒有油覆蓋的醬露在表面乾掉發霉，以及把碰過生雞肉的湯匙伸回罐子。自製的坦都里醃醬以優格為基底，屬於易腐的乳製品：請放 4 °C，並在兩天內用完。
zh.freezer: 罐裝坦都里醬沒有冷凍期限，通常也不需要，因為冷藏已經給了開封後數週到數個月。冷凍真正有用的情況是自製香料基底，或一大罐用不完時：用大匙挖成小球在 −18 °C 凍硬後裝袋。優格醃醬不要單獨冷凍；請把雞肉和醃醬一起冷凍，肉在冷藏解凍的過程中就醃好了。
zh.thawing: 冷凍醬球請放冷藏解凍，或直接丟進熱鍋。醃著肉的請只放冷藏解凍，用過的醃醬一律丟棄，不要重複使用。
spoilage: 醬面或露出油面的醬體長霉
油發出油耗味或蠟筆味
有發酵味或酵母味、產氣，或蓋子鼓起
表面乾成深色硬殼，底下分離出液體
tips: 在肉靠近罐子之前，先把要用的量舀出來。
每次用完擦瓶口、抹平表面。
醃過生肉的醃醬已經被污染：直接丟掉，不要倒回罐子，也不要刷到熟食上。
大罐請分裝成小球冷凍，不要讓它開著放好幾個月。

faq.q: 坦都里醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 1～2 個月；標籤若有註明開封後期限，以標籤為準。

faq.q: 未開封的坦都里醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 2 年，以標示日期為準。這個數字借自泰式紅咖哩醬。

faq.q: 自製坦都里醃醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 它是以優格為基底的乳製品：放 4 °C，並在兩天內用完。

faq.q: 醃過生雞肉的醃醬還能用嗎？
faq.a: 不行，它已經被污染。請直接丟掉，不要刷到熟食上，也不要倒回罐子。
